plan.title: Scholarship Progress & Pending Cases by District
plan.subtitle: District-level distribution of scholarship applications, approvals, and pending reviews

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_apps FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" IN ('Pending', 'Under Review')

panels.title: Pending Rate
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Pending', 'Under Review') THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pending_pct FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Application Status by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed') THEN 1 END) AS approved_or_disbursed, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Pending', 'Under Review') THEN 1 END) AS pending_or_review, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Rejected' THEN 1 END) AS rejected FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "District" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pending Cases by Scheme
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme" AS scheme_name, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" IN ('Pending', 'Under Review') AND "Name of scheme" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: District & Taluka Pending Caseload
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, "Taluka" AS taluka, COUNT(*) AS total_applicants, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Pending', 'Under Review') THEN 1 END) AS pending_cases, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Pending', 'Under Review') THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pending_rate_pct FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "District" IS NOT NULL AND "Taluka" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY pending_cases DESC

plan.narrative:
Across all regions, a total of {{kpi_total_apps.total_apps}} scholarship applications have been recorded. Out of these, {{kpi_pending_cases.pending_count}} cases remain unresolved, representing a backlog rate of {{kpi_pending_pct.pending_pct}}% across pending and under-review statuses.

The distribution across districts highlights regional operational differences, while the scheme breakdown identifies which scholarship programs require expedited verification.
